svg.title: Pearl Hall — Pearl-lit fan dais
svg.desc: A fan of shell ribs leads to Amaya’s dais. Side galleries separate Tide Chamber, Deepvault and shrine descent; benches and a record table add small playable surfaces. Editable design layers: architecture, walkable ledges, supported climbs, jumpable props, numbered exits and NPCs.

g.text: Climbable stairs / ladders / ropes · pale edges are landable
Solid route stays open · furniture tops add optional hops

svg.text: A fan of shell ribs leads to Amaya’s dais. Side galleries separate Tide Chamber, Deepvault
and shrine descent; benches and a record table add small playable surfaces.
5 raised landings · 2 stairs · 1 ropes · 2 ladders · 20 props

P1 Deepvault · P2 Gatehall of Shells · P3 Shrine Causeway · P4 The Tide Chamber
